content.title: Fix transparent/unreadable shadcn-ui styles in webapp (inputs, selects, modals)
content.description: Inputs, select boxes, and modals in the webapp all appear transparent, making their content very difficult to read. The shadcn-ui theme does not appear to be correctly applied — styles are missing or not loaded. Investigate the root cause (missing CSS imports, Tailwind config, shadcn-ui theme variables, global stylesheet) and fix so all components render with proper backgrounds, borders, and text contrast.
